protocol_audit.scope: Supplemental audit of EVERY raw return attempt, created return proposal, committed return and final return order on tasks whose authored initial operation is exchange. Gold only selects the audit cohort; actual grants require a successful scoped question, subsequent exact YES, active context and matching observed order/replacement/revision/payment. Rejected attempts, unconsented proposals and committed returns are separate counts. Expected business outcome and initial false-positive labels never exempt a return from this audit.
protocol_audit.limitations: Uses frozen current_request reply projections on raw event prefixes, not decision_gate. Cohort is authored benchmark exchanges, not unrestricted real conversations with genuine customer operation changes. No direct-return semantic authorization audit.
